author_role: Archive-module author, distinct from original-loop integrator and independent source reviewer

validation.command: python3 heredoc: ast.parse(source, filename=str(p)); compile(source, str(p), "exec", dont_inherit=True)
validation.scope: Only Python syntax/compilation and source/metadata hashing; no archive constructor, tensor materialization or model behavior executed

work/S35_generation_integration/archive_.scope: New implementation, full static read, AST parse and in-memory compile; not imported or called

docs/S20_MINIMAL_VIDEO_PROTOCOL_DRAFT.md.scope: Full draft protocol read in sections

src/s20_generation_trace.py.scope: Canonical tensor codec/writer and batch/commit interfaces; offline verifier not re-audited

work/S35_generation_integration/review_r.scope: Full independent S35 review requirements read

work/S17C_interface_preparation/isolated.scope: Symbol/call-location search only; not the future S35 runtime identity, which integrator binds separately

api.capture: capture(name, payload) -> ordered archive reference, synchronous full raw tree serialization
api.finalize: finalize(*, status="COMPLETE"|"PARTIAL", metadata=None) -> manifest path/SHA/archive status; scientific_status NOT_EVALUATED
api.fail: fail(error, *, phase="caller") -> best-effort partial archive; caller re-raises original failure

scope.required_events: Required names/minimum counts only, not scientific validation
scope.big_source_or_weight_sha: Caller responsibility; supplied identities only, no large-file reread
scope.PIL: Already-loaded L/RGB/RGBA only; raw pixels and lossless PNG, not original JPEG bytes nor VAE/CLIP re-encoding
scope.rng: Only explicitly supplied states; archive does not call RNG getter/draw/seed
scope.array_bits: Full S20 canonical C-order/little-endian bytes with dtype/shape/SHA, not fingerprints alone

integration_requirements_pending: Actual sampler-received noise/c/uc/c2w/K/mask and read-only RNG before/after must be captured passively by integrator, not reconstructed from get_cond output
Original all-eight-slot samples/samples_z, full seven/four target CLIP rows, canonical history one/five/nine, all dense geometry and original map/K/depth caches must be supplied by integration caller
Stable loop wiring, root-owned explicit artificial interface check, independent source review, original component resources and separate formal run contract are pending
limitations: No actual archival data written or decoded in this preparation
ARCHIVE_COMPLETE or closed trace cannot certify generation or actual generated-cache conditioning
Do not use S34 packets or surrogate caches as generation outputs
Potential CPU-copy/PNG/hash overhead not measured; must count against external runtime budget
Abrupt kill or full disk may preserve only fsynced prefix and partial blobs; never auto-resume or overwrite
